description: You are standing on a narrow ledge outside the attic window. The wind whistles through your eyelets. Below you, the world of Shoeboxlandia stretches out like a toy set.

wall.description: The brick wall of the house. It's cold and rough.

ledge_floor.description: A narrow stone ledge, covered in a thin layer of soot.

gusty_wind.onInteract: You lean into the wind. It whistles through your eyelets in a soft, musical frequency. It makes you feel incredibly alive!
gusty_wind.description: A powerful gust of wind blowing along the side of the house.

cobweb_corner.onInteract: You examine the dusty cobweb. It's empty, but a sparkling morning dewdrop is caught in the silk. You admire its tiny reflection.
cobweb_corner.description: A dusty cobweb in the corner, catching the morning light.

item.name: Wild Potato
item.opened_description: A cracked brick. Just dirt remains.
item.onCollect: You reach into the brick crack and pull out a tiny, perfectly preserved Wild Potato!

brick_crack.description: A cracked brick with a tiny green clover sprout growing out of it.

exit_west.description: The ledge leads back through the window to the shoe rack.

exit_south.description: A precarious climb down leads to the garden path.

item_pollen.description: A clump of bright yellow pollen has gathered in the corner.
